scope: Strategy after objective-aligned MMTO learning-curve rejection

fixed_mmto_conflict.conclusion: The game-vs intervention works, but ordinary search-rank shared-feature updates move the game-vs subset in the opposite direction much more strongly.

evidence.prior_quiet_expert_failure: The old expert objective used one deterministic quiet legal alternative without evaluator confirmation or online hardness.
evidence.new_signal: Use a recorded WDoor move as positive only against candidates that frozen scratch depth-4 search scores at least 15 cp lower, then choose the currently most overvalued negative.

alternatives.reason: Combines independent WDoor choice with scratch-search confirmation and online hard-negative selection without contradictory labels.
It forces a recorded move above the depth-4 search best even when the frozen teacher scores it lower; aligned offline improvement would not establish playing-strength transfer.
It improves own-search proxy metrics but adds little independent information; the prior one-percent candidate did not improve the paired v2.5.0 score.
It needs generator changes and lacks depth-4 confirmation, while existing HKST already contains search-confirmed candidates.
It increases volume before correcting the known weak-negative problem.
Corrected value training improved its blended objective while worsening the search target.
Implementation and CPU data-generation cost are disproportionate before testing the existing consensus hard-negative path.

implementation_scope: Share game-rank eligibility and hard-negative selection between trainer and evaluator.
Freeze hard-negative identity with the accepted parent for paired model comparisons.
Record eligible count, sample-weighted softplus loss, signed margin, and paired improved/worsened counts.
Select game-rank-only checkpoints by the aligned smooth loss.
Extend the existing objective evaluator; do not add a trainer, optimizer, dataset schema, or dashboard.
required_verification: Model/HKST SHA and all-network-input split rejection.
Targeted tests, full library tests, release build, and zero-loss byte identity.

parent_screen.interpretation: A non-destructive screen only; it does not prove improvement.

step_1_pilot.failure_action: Stop the HKST expert route without tuning the weight, regret cap, epoch count, learning rate, or seed.

requirements: Bind source, teacher, settings, shard range, and output SHA values.
Remove validation records colliding with any train root or candidate network input.

step_3_full_training.selection: Lowest fixed-pair game-rank objective loss among last-epoch artifacts, with every safety gate passing.
